name: AI YouTube Shorts Studio Pro with Google Veo (Hybrid Free Stack)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — 3 free keys + 1 paid model (Veo)

**FREE keys:**
1. `GEMINI_API_KEY` → [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) (script ke liye free; isi key se Veo bhi chalta hai)
2. `PEXELS_API_KEY` → [pexels.com/api](https://www.pexels.com/api/) (fallback footage — free)
3. `JSON2VIDEO_API_KEY` → [json2video.com/get-api-key](https://json2video.com/get-api-key/) (render + Hindi voice + captions — free)
4. Last node pe **YouTube OAuth2** credential

**💰 SIRF Veo paid hai** (billing enable karna hoga — AI Studio → Billing → Pay as you go):
| Model | Cost / video (4 clips x 8s) |
|---|---|
| `veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview` (default) | ~$3.20 (₹270) |
| `veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview` (sasta) | ~$1.60 (₹135) |

Baaki SAB FREE: Gemini 2.5 Pro script ✓ Hindi voiceover ✓ captions ✓ render (600 sec/mo) ✓ YouTube upload ✓

🎙️ Voice: `hi-IN-MadhurNeural` (male) • `hi-IN-SwaraNeural` (female) • English: `en-US-EmmaMultilingualNeural` + `LANGUAGE`=`English`

## 🎬 Hybrid Pro Pipeline — AI footage + free everything else

**TOPIC → publish-ready Short (~4-7 min):**

1. **Gemini 2.5 Pro** (free): SEO title, #Shorts description, tags + 4 scenes (golden hook, Hindi voiceover, Veo prompt, Pexels fallback keyword)
2. **Veo 3.1** (paid): har scene ka cinematic 8s vertical footage — 4 clips parallel, auto-polling
3. **Smart fallback**: Veo kisi scene pe fail ho to wahan **Pexels stock** lag jata hai — video kabhi rukti nahi (sab fail ho tabhi error)
4. **JSON2Video** (free): footage + **Hindi neural voiceover** + **auto-synced boxed captions** + golden hooks + fade transitions + **FOLLOW outro** (1080x1920)
5. Auto-poll → download → **YouTube private upload**

### ⚠️ Notes
- Veo clips 2-6 min lete hain (workflow khud wait karta hai)
- Video **private** upload hoti hai — review karke public karo
- Veo 401/429 = billing enable nahi hai (sticky Setup dekho)
- Style badalna ho to `Build Movie JSON` node edit karo

Voiceover language: ' + $json.LANGUAGE + '. Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly these keys: "title" (catchy SEO title under 90 chars), "description" (2 short lines + exactly 5 hashtags including #Shorts), "tags" (comma separated, 10-12 SEO tags), "scenes" (EXACTLY 4 items, each an object with: "hook" = 3-6 word ALL CAPS punchy on-screen caption, "voiceover" = 1-2 engaging spoken sentences of 15-20 words in the voiceover language (if Hindi, write in Devanagari script), "veo_prompt" = one cinematic 8-second vertical 9:16 b-roll prompt for Google Veo describing subject, camera motion, setting, lighting and mood, strictly NO on-screen text/captions/watermarks/logos, "pexels_query" = 2-3 simple English words for searching stock footage as fallback, e.g. "indian temple aerial").' }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}
